datasets.title: Transcriptome analysis for vorinostat-treated choriocarcinoma cells
datasets.summary: Choriocarcinoma is one of the rare gynecological malignancies with aggressive behavior. Vorinostat is an approved HDAC inhibitor, and HDACs play important roles in regulating gene expression and modulating various cellular processes. Here, the human choriocarcinoma cell lines (JAR and JEG-3) were treated with 1 μM vorinostat or DMSO for 48 h. Then, total RNA was extracted, and transcriptome analysis was performed.

datasets.title: Hsa-miR-371a-5p and hsa-miR-518a-3p regulated genes in choriocarcinoma cells
datasets.summary: We report the application of transcriptome sequencing for investigating of the hsa-miR-371a-5p and hsa-miR-518a-3p regulated genes. JAR, JEG-3 and BeWo choriocarcinoma cells were transfected with hsa-miR-371a-5p or hsa-miR-518a-3p inhibitors or control inhibitors. Totally, 237, 132 and 277 genes with > 2 folds change and adjusted P < 0.05 were upregulated in JAR, JEG-3 and BeWo cells respectively after hsa-miR-371a-5p knockdown. Meanwhile, 229, 269 and 191 genes were upregulated in JAR, JEG-3 and BeWo cells respectively after hsa-miR-518a-3p knockdown. The top upregulated genes included many oncogenes or oncogenesis associated ones. Enrichment analysis showed hsa-miR-371a-5p and hsa-miR-518a-3p regulated diverse pathways related to tumorigenesis and metastasis. Our results would be helpful for the searching of early molecular biomarkers and therapeutic targets for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

datasets.title: The gene expression profile of methotrexate-resistant JAR cells
datasets.summary: Choriocarcinoma is a rare and aggressive malignancy. Although multi-agent chemotherapy is the standard treatment, resistance to anticancer agents remains a significant clinical challenge. In this study, we investigated the gene expression profile of choriocarcinoma cells with acquired resistance to methotrexate (MTX) using mRNA sequencing.
datasets.overall_design: MTX-resistant JAR cells were established by continuous stepwise exposure to increasing concentrations of MTX. The cells were initially cultured in 10 nM MTX, and the concentration was gradually increased over several months. Total RNA was then extracted and subjected to mRNA sequencing.
datasets.study_design: JAR绒毛膜癌细胞系亲本与MTX耐药株的bulk RNA-seq比较

datasets.title: The gene expression profile of JAR cells co-cultured with NK cells.
datasets._0ab341: 索臻生物科技SOGEN·生信+湿实验一站式·一区顶刊课题合作·加群获取增量·微信bioinformaticsboy
datasets.summary: Immune cells play a critical role in cancer progression. In choriocarcinoma, the importance of natural killer (NK) cells has been highlighted, but their impact remains unclear. This study analyzed gene expression changes in choriocarcinoma cells when co-cultured with NK cells in vitro.
datasets.overall_design: JAR cells were co-cultured with NK cells in the presence of 100 IU/mL IL-2 at a ratio of 5:1. As a control, JAR cells were cultured with 100 IU/mL IL-2 without NK cells. After 24 hours of incubation, JAR cells were isolated using flow cytometry, and total RNA was extracted with the miRNeasy Mini Kit. Subsequently, mRNA-sequencing was performed.

datasets.title: Gene expression profiles of a non-gestational choriocarcinoma and its corresponding patient-derived xenograft tumor
datasets.summary: Non-gestational choriocarcinoma (NGC) is a rare subtype of malignant germ cell tumor. We established a patient-derived xenograft (PDX) model using tumor tissue from an 18-year-old patient with NGC. Then, we performed mRNA-seq analysis using the fresh-frozen tissues of the original tumor and the PDX model.
datasets.overall_design: The fresh NGC tumor was subcutaneously transplanted into NSG mice. When the tumor diameter reached approximately 2 cm, the tumors were harvested and passed. The generation harboring the patient-derived material was termed P1, with subsequent generations numbered consecutively (P2, P3, P4, etc.). The tumor tissue of P3  was used for analysis.
